description: Returns every home on an open Zillow or Redfin search tab (the one open_search opened, else the one the user used last), computed with the user's own profile exactly like DoorMeter's search badges: link, address, price, beds, days on market, whether it's new to the user (never opened or saved), score (0–100), cash flow, cash-on-cash and cap rate, or why it can't be computed from the search page. Best score first; "total" counts all matches before the limit.

limit.description: At most this many homes (default 50, max 200).

minScore.description: Only homes scoring at least this.

newOnly.description: Only homes the user has never opened or saved.

anyOf.description: Strategy the numbers are computed in: buy-and-hold, house-hack, brrrr or live-in (living in it).

scoreAs.description: Strategy to compute every home in: buy-and-hold for the user's investor targets (cash-on-cash, cash flow per door, cap rate), live-in for a home to live in against their budget, house-hack or brrrr; "profile" uses each saved home's own and the profile's starting strategy for the rest. Left out, it follows the "Score homes as" switcher on the page.

tabId.description: The tab open_search returned; the most recent search tab when left out.

name: search_results
